; Semantic control 1: a different function entirely. Two callees whose names
; happen to share a prefix are still two callees.
declare i32 @helper_other(i32)
declare void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr, i8, i64, i1)

define i32 @f(ptr %p, i32 %x) {
entry:
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %p, i8 0, i64 32, i1 false)
  %r = call i32 @helper_other(i32 %x)
  ret i32 %r
}
